sections.title: Verdict
sections.text: RED on candidate 1de6f832. One independent audit in Codex session 01a120c3-ecac-7b71-bf39-8edf762cfa86, observed route codex/gpt-6.1-sol/high, cwd /home/vostrikov/projects/packages/swissknifeman-next, -a never -s danger-full-access. The session did not implement the candidate. Scope: P7 product diff a686ef16..1de6f832, item checks/deliverables and integration seams. Recorded unchanged V1–V5 of P7.7 reused; no broad rerun. Targeted throwaway reproductions below. Original vault untouched.

sections.title: Findings
sections.text:
F1 high, owner P7.2, packages/brain/lib/brain/docs.py:152-159: generated sync-brain.sh push uses unconditional cp -p, so a changed vault document is overwritten without --force. Reproduction: project README 'repository copy', vault README 'USER VAULT EDIT'; DocsSync.push() preserves the vault and reports one conflict, generated script push exits 0 and replaces it with repository copy. Violates phase rule 7 and the documented conflict policy.
F2 medium, owner P7.3, configs/release-units.json:38-44,54: brain is a package version owner/runtime package, but packages/brain/package.json does not exist. aicore.release.attestation.build(root, None, package_root=root/packages/skiller) raises FileNotFoundError for that path; version-guard/release attestation cannot run.
F3 medium, owner P7.4, packages/brain/lib/brain/events.py:70-85: parse_time clamps seconds and never bounds offset fields; closed_at 2026-10-09T09:59:99Z and +99:99 are accepted, while 0001-01-01T00:00:00+01:00 raises bare OverflowError. Malformed events must give EVENT_DATA_INVALID/65, not a wrong note date or traceback.
F4 low, owner P7.1, knowledge/review-P7-1-2026-10-09.json:1: reviewer document has neither applies_to nor global; plan check warns context_unbound. Bind to P7.1.
Completion gap, owner P7.7, phases/P7/P7.7.json:5: blocked only for push/V6; prior V1–V5 are green. Owner explicitly authorized repair, commit and push in this session.

sections.title: Recommendations
sections.text: Preserve changed vault files in generated push by default, report DOCS_CONFLICT, add explicit --force and regressions for generated push/bidirectional. Supply compatible brain package version metadata and validate its agreement with the module/runtime/plugin version, plus host attestation regression. Bound RFC3339 numeric fields, contain UTC overflow as EVENT_DATA_INVALID and add parser/CLI regressions. Link the review through the API. One owning correction under reopened P7.7 (red integration checks), affected checks only; reuse unchanged broad checks, run final live push/V6. Repair verification by this same session is executor evidence, not an independent GREEN re-audit.

sections.title: Owning correction and validation
sections.text: Executor continuation in the same session, explicitly authorized by the owner after requesting the audit. F1: generated push reports DOCS_CONFLICT/1, preserves differing vault bytes/mtime and identical files, copies other new files, supports explicit push --force; four shell regressions. F2: brain/package.json supplies 0.1.0, module validation checks runtime/module/plugin/package agreement; host test builds the whole attestation and verifies brain and package.brain version sources. F3: seconds >60 and offset hour >23/minute >59 are rejected; UTC range overflow becomes EVENT_DATA_INVALID/65; parser and CLI regressions assert no traceback/no note. Numeric ranges verified against RFC 3339 §5.6, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339#section-5.6. F4: API applies_to link to P7.1; plan check now 0 errors/0 warnings. Checks: brain validate (213 tests), host version-guard tests (6), boundaries/render/standalone brain, golden/public hygiene in a clean copy of current tracked and nonignored worktree inputs, schema compat against a686ef16 (18 contracts, 0 errors/warnings), and V3 on a sandbox copy of the actual ~/Vaults/Brain vault (old nested path missing): two notes, replay no duplicate, failed delivery retried, two causation events, original git status unchanged. Unchanged P7.7 broad V1/V2 and unrelated standalone inputs reused from candidate 1de6f832; only their affected delta rerun. Documentation and both changelogs updated. No second independent audit: the initial RED verdict is retained; these are executor correction checks. Remaining release-only work: nine pre-existing units need version increases before the P13 major release boundary; brain is a new 0.1.0 unit. Local ignored next-base-tooling registry conflict recorded as an environment follow-up, source checks pass in isolation. Push and V6 pending at this entry.
